title: PillarProjection
description: Declares how an EPR atom of a given kind is projected into a pillar's read-model SQL table. The projector controller (alongside ReconcileController) iterates registered projections, evaluates each entry's columnMapping over an atom's payload, and UPSERTs the result into targetTable. Source-of-truth for the row remains the signed Envelope in epr_atoms (Category A); the projection is operational state (Category C) — fully rebuildable from the cursor. Manifest-authority guard: only EPR atoms whose (kind, schemaKey) match a declared projection are projected — unmapped kinds remain in epr_atoms but produce no pillar row (Invariant I6).

kind.description: EPR atom kind this projection consumes. Must be one of the nine notarized EprKind values.

schemaKey.description: Application-level schema discriminator within the kind (e.g. 'economic-event' for shefa's EconomicEvent atoms). Combined with kind, forms the manifest-authority guard for projection (Invariant I2).

targetTable.description: Name of the SQLite table to UPSERT projected rows into. Table must exist in elohim-storage with a primary key on the source EPR's content-address (cid) — that's the dht_anchor for the A-class source and ensures idempotent replay (Invariant I1).

columnMapping.description: Map of target column name -> dotted source path within the EPR payload. Path is evaluated against the decoded payload (canonical_bytes). Special source paths (e.g. '$verifiedAt') resolve to projector-derived values rather than payload fields.
